scientific_goal: Learn a structured TCN63 Neural-SDE entirely from the full untrimmed 0p10 training population, without loading any trimmed-data weights, and determine whether an economical conditional velocity energy score plus optional endpoint moment matching yields stable and statistically faithful autonomous rollouts.
scientific_constraints: No trial in the fresh lineage may load the earlier trimmed checkpoint. The fresh one-step parent and direct energy-score arm start from random initialization with normalization fitted only to the untrimmed training population; fine-tunes may load only checkpoints created inside this study.
Use validation repetitions 13 and 14 for all tuning and selection. Test repetitions 15 and 16 remain locked.

Keep the rank-20 shared-POD data, stored 50 Hz high-pass spatial mean, native-lag velocity state, structured positive diagonal restoring plus damping drift, TCN63 residual and diagonal diffusion fixed.

The fresh one-step control establishes whether staged one-step pretraining is needed. The direct fresh energy arm tests energy-score training from random initialization; staged energy arms must use only the fresh untrimmed one-step parent.

Use the unbiased conditional velocity energy score in target-standardized coordinates with four independent paths per measured initial condition and no self-pairs. M=8 already produced a practically identical warm-started solution at twice the path cost, so do not increase the ensemble unless new evidence demands it.

Prefer batch-level multistep sampling at fraction 0.005: it evaluates full selected minibatches rarely, retaining roughly six thousand initial conditions per epoch while vectorizing TCN rollout work. Treat its inverse-frequency gradient variance separately from estimator quality.

Do not infer success from one-step NLL or finite trajectories alone. Compare energy, POD means and covariance, leading-mode amplitudes, PSD, ACF, innovation calibration and rollout survival against the untrimmed validation reference.

Moment matching is a second-stage calibration tool. First establish an energy-only result; then add mean and, only if justified, light variance matching. Report their weighted contributions and do not attribute energy-score effects to moments.

The declared direct and staged controls run before adaptive decisions. Later trials may vary energy weight, maximum horizon, moment weights, learning rate, batch sampling mode or diagonal-linear orthogonality only within the allowed alternatives.
Changing maximum energy horizon requires the matching particle-count schedule in the same decision. Horizon 50 is exploratory and must remain below the wall-clock cap.
Every individual training subprocess has a hard 2700-second wall-clock limit. A timeout is a failed economic model, its partial directory is retained, and it must not be continued.

Screen each checkpoint on 32 independent full-diffusion validation paths for 5000 steps. Reject nonfinite paths, peak POD standardized RMS above 10, absolute standardized coordinate above 50, energy outside [0.4,2.5] or covariance trace outside [0.4,2.5].

At most one candidate receives an independent 50000-step confirmation. Prefer the simplest and fastest candidate that matches the confirmed warm-started untrimmed models rather than maximizing auxiliary-objective complexity.
advisor_guidance: The matched warm-start study found M=4 and M=8 energy-score arms nearly identical at weight 0.3: both had about 1.08 times untrimmed energy, 1.07 covariance trace, 0.12 covariance error and 0.10 decades POD-only center PSD error on the 10000-step screen. Therefore use M=4. This study asks a different question: whether those dynamics can be learned without any trimmed checkpoint. First compare the direct fresh energy arm with the staged fresh one-step then energy arm. A divergent one-step screen does not invalidate it as a fine-tuning parent if its checkpoint and local fit are finite. If staged energy training is promising, test combined mean matching before raising energy weight; add variance only for a diagnosed covariance/amplitude error. Batch-level sampling is selected for throughput, but an examples-sampling check is allowed if update variance appears problematic. Orthogonality is a late ablation, not a default explanation. Never exceed 45 minutes for a training subprocess.

seed_runs.hypothesis: External warm-started energy-score reference; used only for comparison and never as a training parent.
External confirmed untrimmed MC-GMM plus variance reference; used only as a target level and never as a training parent.

initial_trials.hypothesis: Five epochs of one-step joint training learn a well-calibrated local structured TCN model entirely from untrimmed data, supplying a fair parent for generated-history objectives.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Good held-out one-step NLL and innovation behavior but potentially unstable or biased autonomous rollouts, which subsequent energy-score training should correct.

initial_trials.hypothesis: A short-horizon energy score active from random initialization can learn local and closed-loop dynamics jointly without a separate one-step stage.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Finite training below 45 minutes and a 5000-step rollout competitive with the staged arm; failure would support one-step pretraining as an optimization curriculum.

initial_trials.hypothesis: MC-GMM feedback active from random initialization stabilizes and calibrates the same fresh untrimmed TCN more effectively than the direct energy-score objective.
initial_trials.expected_observation: A finite matched 5000-step screen with energy, means and covariance closer to the untrimmed reference than the direct fresh energy arm; otherwise the difficulty is not specific to the energy-score objective.

initial_trials.hypothesis: MC-GMM fine-tuning of the identical fresh untrimmed one-step parent supplies stronger closed-loop distributional information than the staged energy score.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Improved 5000-step energy and POD moments relative to fresh_staged_energy_h10_w0p3_e3 without sacrificing its finite survival or local conditional fit.
